Subject: Quick sync: exec intro + demo — VP & CIO presence?

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — AuroraCorp is excited to see Redwood's inference platform in action. Our CIO (Mark Hollis) and VP of Platform (Sarah Lee) would like a short executive briefing followed by a 45-minute demo. Ideally they'd have a 15-minute pre-brief to cover security questions, then the main run-of-show.

Can you hold a provisional 75-minute window next week? Our preferred times (PST): Tue 8/11 10:00–11:15am, Wed 8/12 2:00–3:15pm. If you can suggest internal sponsor coverage and a brief agenda that would help.

I'll attach our initial security questionnaire. -- attaching auroracorp-security-questions.pdf

Cheers,

Thanks — we can run that. Provisional hold: Tue 8/11 10:00–11:15am PT (75 mins). Confirm please and I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in + doc links.

Also uploading our sponsor NDA and a short pre-demo checklist — feel free to add anything specific you need.

Thanks,
